explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for this. The theorem says that operators in the library's own `opFamily` commute. These operators are built from its Hecke operators (`heckeTL`, `diamondL`) acting on modular-curve cohomology, and the generators come from the library's type `Gen N S`. Mathlib has no Hecke operators on modular-symbol or cohomology spaces. The proof splits into cases on the generators and applies the library's own lemma `heckeT_comm_of_prime`. The only Mathlib inputs are generic: `Nat.coprime_primes` and `LinearMap.ext`. So the content of the result lies in the library's own definitions. I did not grep Mathlib, because these constants exist only in this library.
